product: Immunology (Skyrizi, Rinvoq, Humira), neuroscience (Vraylar, Botox Therapeutic, Ubrelvy, Qulipta, Vyalev), oncology (Venclexta, Imbruvica, Elahere, Decnupaz) and Allergan Aesthetics (Botox Cosmetic, Juvederm).
demand: Q2 2026 net revenues were 16.990B USD, up 10.2 pct reported and 9.5 pct operational, with immunology up 15.1 pct and neuroscience up 20.3 pct.
pricing_power: Mixed. Growth is volume driven, and the company argues publicly that German policy cuts the value of an innovative medicine by nearly 54 pct via mandatory manufacturer rebates raised from 7 pct to 15.5 pct.
competition: Immunology rivals include J and J, Amgen, Lilly, Novartis and UCB; Humira faces biosimilars; oncology faces competing BCMA bispecifics and BCL-2 inhibitors.
team: Robert A. Michael is chairman and chief executive officer; Scott T. Reents is executive vice president and chief financial officer; Roopal Thakkar leads research and development as chief scientific officer; Nicholas Donoghoe is chief business and strategy officer.
market_strategy: Large-scale M and A to rebuild the pipeline (Apogee), AI enabled discovery partnerships (Iambic), broad label expansion across RINVOQ, Skyrizi and neuroscience, and a growing dividend declared 2026-09-10 at 1.73 USD per share.
bull: Q2 2026 revenue 16.990B USD up 10.2 pct with immunology up 15.1 pct and neuroscience up 20.3 pct; Skyrizi up 24.4 pct and Rinvoq up 24.5 pct; 20 of 21 analysts raised targets in 90 days (median +7.6 pct).
bear: 2026 adjusted EPS guidance trimmed to 13.87-14.07; Humira down 35.9 pct, Imbruvica down 29.4 pct, aesthetics flat; Apogee dilutes EPS 0.14 in 2026 and 0.46 in 2027, accretive only 2032, funded with over 10B USD new debt.
falsifier: Q3 2026 adjusted EPS reported below the guided 3.84-3.88 range, or 2026 adjusted EPS guided below 13.87, would show the growth story is not converting to earnings.
web_what_changed: Closed the Apogee Therapeutics acquisition for about 10.9B USD equity value at 135.11 USD per share on 2026-09-03 (announced 2026-06-22); funded partly by a 2026-08-18 senior notes offering over 10B USD; Q2 2026 revenue 16.990B USD up 10.2 pct (2026-07-31); EC RINVOQ approvals for polyarticular JIA 2026-09-22, vitiligo and alopecia areata; 2026 adjusted EPS guidance trimmed to 13.87-14.07.
web_not_known_yesterday: No primary company disclosure dated 2026-09-24 or 2026-09-25 was found. The newest verifiable datapoints remain the 2026-09-22 EC RINVOQ pJIA approval, the 2026-09-22 USTR Section 301 testimony on German pricing, and the 2026-09-23 Piper Sandler reiteration at 303 USD.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Growth reads as volume and mix led, not price. Skyrizi up 24.4 pct and Rinvoq up 24.5 pct offset Humira down 35.9 pct to 756M USD; neuroscience up 20.3 pct; aesthetics only up 0.3 pct reported, down 0.9 pct operational. No explicit price metric is disclosed.
web_suppliers: Not found. The press releases, 8-K exhibits and filings read name no suppliers and disclose no input constraints; AbbVie manufacturing and supply arrangements are not detailed in the sources reviewed.
web_customers: Not found. The sources read disclose only portfolio and geographic revenue splits for Q2 2026 and give no customer names or concentration figures.
web_who_loses: Rival immunology franchises lose share as Skyrizi and Rinvoq grow, and Humira biosimilars lose as AbbVie shifts mix. In myeloma, etentamig Phase 3 CERVINO success pressures competing BCMA bispecifics and standard therapies; IL-13 and TSLP entrants face Apogee zumilokibart.
web_contradicting_evidence: Guidance cut to 13.87-14.07 from 13.91-14.11. Humira down 35.9 pct, Imbruvica down 29.4 pct, oncology down 1.5 pct, aesthetics flat and down 0.9 pct operationally. Apogee dilutes EPS 0.14 USD in 2026 and about 0.46 USD in 2027, accretive only 2032, funded with cash plus new debt; Q2 net interest expense 679M USD. Own USTR filing flags German rebates rising 7 pct to 15.5 pct.
web_if_management_right: Immunology and neuroscience momentum continues, Apogee IL-13 assets progress toward stated mega-blockbuster peak sales, CERVINO supports etentamig filing, and 2026 adjusted EPS lands in the 13.87-14.07 range with Q3 2026 guided at 3.84-3.88.
web_if_management_wrong: Ex-US pricing and reimbursement pressure plus Apogee clinical or integration risk bite first; Humira and Imbruvica erosion outruns new launches, aesthetics stays flat, and interest cost on the new debt plus EPS dilution compress growth well before 2032 accretion.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: AI drug discovery vendors such as Iambic, contract manufacturers and specialty distributors, the PR Newswire wire, and combination partners across atopic dermatitis, asthma and multiple myeloma; also holders of adjacent IL-13 and TSLP assets re-rated by the Apogee price.
